summary: Work items with a status, an owner and a due date; an agent can be summoned on a row.

props.name: Actor
props.note: Name an agent here to summon it on this row. Leave empty on rows anyone may create.

notes: The title column is created by the blank template; read its name from databases.list, never assume it.
Outcome is the agent's column: a change that touches only Status or Outcome does not re-summon.
Leave Actor empty unless the owner asks for an agent on the row, and leave summon_policy at owner.
